questions.q: Why did the Beginner project's scheduled refresh work without any extra setup?
options: SQL Server data never needs to refresh
AdventureWorks2012 is hosted in the cloud
The Beginner project never used Scheduled Refresh
Its data source was a plain SQL Server connector, which the Power BI Service can run directly without needing a local runtime
questions.explain: The Service can speak the SQL Server protocol itself, with no extra infrastructure required.

questions.q: Why can't the Power BI Service run this project's Python script data source on its own?
options: The Service only supports R scripts, not Python
The Service is a cloud product with no Python runtime and cannot execute an arbitrary local script
pandas is incompatible with Power BI entirely
Python scripts are not allowed in Power Query at all
questions.explain: Unlike a SQL connector, a Python script actually needs to run somewhere with Python installed, and the Service itself isn't that somewhere.

options: A small application installed on a real machine with the needed runtime (Python/pandas), which the Service tells to run the script on a schedule
A cloud-hosted Python interpreter run by Microsoft
A setting inside Power BI Desktop with no separate installation
A type of DAX measure
questions.explain: The On-premises data gateway (personal mode) lets the Service delegate script execution to a real machine.

questions.q: What happens if Scheduled Refresh is turned on without connecting a Personal Gateway for this project?
options: It works exactly the same as a SQL connector
It silently uses stale cached data with no error
The refresh fails outright with an error pointing at the missing gateway
Power BI automatically installs Python in the cloud to compensate
questions.explain: This is real, documented Power BI behavior -- a Python-script source fails without the proper gateway, not a soft inconvenience.

questions.q: Where must the gateway machine have Python and pandas installed?
options: On Microsoft's own servers, unrelated to any local machine
Nowhere -- the Service provides it automatically once a gateway exists
On the real machine running the gateway application itself
Only inside Power BI Desktop
questions.explain: The gateway delegates execution to the machine it's installed on, so that machine needs the actual runtime and packages.
